source_text: Fictional standup: Lin said the migration script passes on staging, so we freeze the event schema on Friday. Someone should publish the freeze announcement. The report redesign was postponed; the owner will be decided by email. Next review point was not stated.

review_checks: 核对所有事实能在输入资料或已接受引用中找到。

缺失或未确认信息必须明确标注；不得新增授权、执行或生产完成声明。
